title: Preparative Separation of Antioxidants from Sea Buckthorn and Its Antioxidant Activity In Vitro via Endothelial Function Regulation.
authors: Cheng, Yurong; Kang, Wenjuan; Hu, Jingwen; Fan, Xueru; Nan, Xingmei; Zhang, Zonghao; Yang, Fang
one_liner_zh: 该文从沙棘中分离抗氧化成分并进行分子对接与细胞实验，虽涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sea buckthorn, a homologue of medicine and food, contains a host of bioactives that can prevent many diseases, especially cardiovascular diseases. The association between oxidative stress (OS) and cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) has been well-established, with OS ultimately leading to CVDs through lipid peroxidation and other mechanisms. In this study, antioxidant components were isolated from sea buckthorn by polyamide medium-pressure chromatography coupled with an HPLC-DPPH activity screening system. Two potential compounds were isolated and identified as Tetrahydroharmol and Isorhamnetin3-O-(6-O-E-sinapoyl)-beta-D-glucopyranosyl-(1-2)-beta-D-glucopyranoside-7-O-alpha-L-rhamnopyranoside. Molecular docking technology was used to explore the binding ability of two antioxidant active components to target proteins (LDH, SOD, Nrf2, iNOS, and eNOS). In addition, the antioxidant capacity was determined by EA.hy926 human umbilical vein endothelial fusion cell experiments. The results demonstrate the efficacy of this method for isolating high-purity antioxidants from sea buckthorn. These two activity compounds exhibit potential effects against cardiovascular diseases through antioxidant mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 沙棘，作为一种药食同源的植物，含有大量生物活性成分，能够预防多种疾病，尤其是心血管疾病。氧化应激（OS）与心血管疾病（CVDs）之间的关联已被充分证实，OS通过脂质过氧化及其他机制最终导致心血管疾病。本研究通过聚酰胺中压色谱结合HPLC-DPPH活性筛选系统，从沙棘中分离抗氧化成分。分离并鉴定出两种潜在化合物，分别为四氢哈尔满（Tetrahydroharmol）和异鼠李素3-O-(6-O-E-芥子酰基)-β-D-吡喃葡萄糖基-(1-2)-β-D-吡喃葡萄糖苷-7-O-α-L-吡喃鼠李糖苷（Isorhamnetin3-O-(6-O-E-sinapoyl)-beta-D-glucopyranosyl-(1-2)-beta-D-glucopyranoside-7-O-alpha-L-rhamnopyranoside）。采用分子对接技术探讨了这两种抗氧化活性成分与靶蛋白（LDH、SOD、Nrf2、iNOS和eNOS）的结合能力。此外，通过EA.hy926人脐静脉内皮融合细胞实验测定了抗氧化能力。结果表明，该方法能有效从沙棘中分离高纯度抗氧化剂。这两种活性化合物通过抗氧化机制展现出对抗心血管疾病的潜在作用。
